items.exampleEn: Many students rent rooms near the school.
items.exampleZh: 很多學生在學校附近租房間。

items.exampleEn: Online banking is fast and easy.
The children looked for treasure on the beach.
I need some coins for the bus.
items.exampleZh: 我需要一些硬幣搭公車。

items.exampleEn: Can we have the bill, please?
I bought shampoo at the drugstore.
items.exampleZh: 我在藥妝店買了洗髮精。

items.exampleEn: My aunt has a bookshop in a small town.
items.exampleZh: 我阿姨在一個小鎮開了一家書店。

items.sentenceEn: Did you pay the phone bill?

items.audioEn: The rent for this apartment is ten thousand dollars a month.
items.audioZh: 這間公寓的租金一個月一萬元。
items.questionZh: 這間公寓每個月租金多少？

items.sentenceEn: The rent is too high for me.
items.sentenceZh: 這個租金對我來說太高了。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather keeps old coins in a box.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺把舊硬幣收在一個盒子裡。

items.stemEn: I want to buy a book. Is there a ____ near here?
items.stemZh: 我想買一本書，這附近有書店嗎？

items.stemEn: We always ____ a car when we travel.
items.stemZh: 我們旅行時總是會租車。

items.passageEn: Last week, we helped Grandpa clean his house and found an old box. Inside were some old coins and an old receipt from a bookshop. "This is my treasure," Grandpa said. When he was young, he worked at a drugstore. With the first money he earned, he paid the rent for a small room and bought his first book.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們幫爺爺打掃房子，發現了一個舊盒子。裡面有一些舊硬幣和一張書店的舊收據。爺爺說：「這是我的寶物。」他年輕的時候在藥房工作。他用第一筆薪水付了一個小房間的租金，還買了人生第一本書。

questions.questionZh: 他們在盒子裡發現了什麼？
options: 一把舊鑰匙和幾封舊信
一張舊地圖和一把鑰匙

questions.questionZh: 爺爺年輕時在哪裡工作？

rubricZh: 「銀行業」可寫例如 banking；寫 works at a bank 意思相近，也可以
主詞第三人稱單數，動詞加 s（例如 works）

items.instructionZh: 用 rent 造一個句子，說說你租過或想租的東西，或你的房租。
referenceEn: I want to rent a bike at the beach.
My rent is twelve thousand dollars a month.
rubricZh: rent 可當動詞「租」（例如 rent a bike），也可當名詞「租金」（例如 my rent）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 My rent is）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：an old bill from a bookshop 不自然：書店買書留下的應是 receipt（收據），bill 多指待付帳單；且中譯「書店的舊帳單」也怪。建議改成其他場景的 bill，或改寫
